_comment: Configuration for the mainstage creature-server. Shipped by the package and
version-controlled in the creature-server repo, so production settings live
with the code instead of only inside a systemd unit. Matches how
creature-world ships /etc/creature/world.json.
This is a dpkg conffile: your edits survive package upgrades, and dpkg asks
before replacing it.
Precedence is config file < environment < command line, so anything here can
be overridden for one run without editing the file.
SECRETS DO NOT BELONG HERE. VOICE_API_KEY and HONEYCOMB_API_KEY go in
/etc/default/creature-server, which the unit reads as an EnvironmentFile.
expressive_voice_model is the ElevenLabs model for dialog and pre-rendered
voice files, which want performed audio tags more than low latency. Ad-hoc
speech is NOT this setting: each creature carries its own voice.model_id,
which has to be one of the fast families.
adhoc_voice_model is the model EVERY creature speaks ad-hoc with. It
replaces the old per-creature voice.model_id, which the server no longer
reads. Its value also picks the socket: a v4 model performs audio tags
like [sighs] over the text-to-dialogue socket and reaches first audio in
about 140 ms, which beats the fast models. Setting a fast model such as
eleven_flash_v2_5 falls back to the text-to-speech socket, which is the
escape hatch if v4 ever regresses.
